summary: The proposal appears to have a generally coherent structure and supporting components, but the Problem section needs revision to distinguish the underlying problem from proposed solutions or workarounds. Several passive constructions also obscure responsibility and should be rewritten for greater clarity, so the proposal needs substantial work before submission.

findings.title: Problem section presents alternative solutions
findings.description: The Problem section includes descriptions of alternative solutions or workarounds rather than focusing solely on the underlying problem and its consequences. Remove the shared-login and full-administrative-rights examples, or reframe them explicitly as evidence of the problem and its risks.

locations.quote: A student who needs a host, a channel, and a repository asks several people and waits for each of them, and some bridge the delay with a **shared login** that hides who acted.

The **common workaround hands maintainers full administrative rights**, which violates the principle of least privilege [SS75] and exposes every user and every host to a mistake made for a single project.

findings.title: Use active voice for actor-dependent actions
findings.description: Rewrite the identified passive constructions with explicit subjects and active verbs, particularly where the responsible actor or system component matters to the design.

locations.quote: and access granted for one project outlives the time a person spends at the chair.
